data.name: Logistics / Freight Forwarding SaaS Platform
data.description: Worked on a freight forwarding SaaS platform covering shipments, quotes, routing, cargo, parties, documents, and operational workflows. Improved operational workflows, usability, and maintainability for logistics users.

data.name: Workflow Automation Engine
data.description: Worked on workflow automation capabilities including workflow definitions, executions, triggers, queues, failed-execution handling, and monitoring. Improved process automation, execution tracking, diagnostics, and system visibility.

data.name: Logistics Integration Platform
data.description: Worked on integrations between logistics systems and external platforms, including message processing, validation, retries, duplicate and out-of-order handling, synchronization, and troubleshooting. Improved reliability and traceability of integration flows and reduced operational issues from failed or inconsistent messages.

data.name: Production Diagnostics & Performance Investigation
data.description: Investigated production issues across SQL Server, Azure SQL, and IIS, including high CPU, blocking, query performance, wait statistics, logs, and monitoring dashboards. Improved incident analysis, operational visibility, and system stability.

data.name: AI-Assisted Logistics Operations
data.description: Built and explored AI-assisted workflows for logistics operations: booking-confirmation email extraction, shipment-update review flows, airline tracking extraction, and human-in-the-loop automation. Explored practical AI use cases that reduce manual work while keeping business users in control.

data.name: Carrier Compliance SaaS MVP
data.description: Designed and built a SaaS MVP for carrier compliance: insurance-certificate tracking, expiration alerts, audit history, compliance status, and lightweight operational dashboards. Demonstrated building a product concept from idea to deployable MVP.

data.name: Lightweight Freight Management SaaS — TMS Product Concept
data.description: Designed a modern lightweight TMS concept covering shipments, quotes, consoles, parties, cargo, routing, documents, onboarding, sample data, and multilingual support. Converted logistics domain knowledge into structured requirements, backlogs, and user workflows.
